title: Infinity Connect Group
category: Brand Identity • Brand Guidelines • Corporate Brochure • Visual Identity • Editorial Design
description: A visual identity and corporate brochure for Infinity Connect Group. The supplied designs connect a circular ICG mark, a dark navy-and-teal palette, a pattern system and product/service editorial pages.
challenge: Connect a technical product and service portfolio through a clear visual identity and a consistent brochure layout.
solution: A circular connectivity motif carries through the logo and patterns. Navy and teal provide a shared palette, while the brochure uses structured product grids and clear section dividers.
results: Selected identity-system pages and brochure spreads from the supplied files. Product brands inside the brochure are presented as editorial content, not as separate identity-design claims.

chapters.title: Identity & logo system
chapters.note: Selected design pages from the supplied brand-book file. Competitor logos and previous concepts are excluded.
